mechanism: Applies {{conceptual_decomposition}} to right-action, producing a non-entangled pipeline that prevents the is-ought entanglement that corrupts monolithic moral reasoning. Operationalizes Hume's is-ought distinction as an architectural boundary: calculate, then think. A prediction solver outputs a typed prediction ledger (branching future states with causal mechanisms and confidence envelopes) — constrained to pure description, no single point forecast. Downstream, a valuation solver evaluates 'which causal pathways matter, at what confidence, over what horizon' and emits a typed score sheet — quantitative ranking no normative consideration has yet touched. Crucially, a principle solver acts as both an acceptance gate and a formal override: if a top-ranked option trips a sacred value, a catastrophic tail risk, or a procedural precedent, it emits a typed judgment note overriding the numerical scoring. The final decision record has two distinct layers — quantitative base and qualitative override — segregated and independently auditable. This is the contract's override-with-documentation mechanism applied to ethics: the override is not an escape from the architecture but a first-class artifact within it. Composes with {{deliberative_align}} for constitutional grounding.
gloss: Separate prediction (is) from valuation (ought) from principle (override), each behind a typed boundary — the decision record has auditable empirical and normative layers
invariants: Is-ought boundary: the prediction stage's output is constrained to pure description; no normative consideration contaminates the empirical forecast.
Override-as-first-class: principle overrides do not adjust prediction weights silently — they emit a typed judgment note that appears in the auditable decision record.
Two-layer record: the empirical base (what the forecast said) and the qualitative override (why we diverged) remain independently inspectable; no collapse into a single verdict.

Bounded override: an override must cite the specific sacred value, tail risk, or procedural precedent it invokes. An override citing none is undocumented, and a protocol that overrides every ranking has replaced its own scoring rather than gating it.

_meta.caution: Required at autonomous-system decision points where both forecast quality and normative legitimacy must be auditable. Collapsing prediction and valuation into one pass re-introduces smuggled normativity — the failure this protocol exists to prevent.
